evidence.reason: Line 177 substitutes both `%i` and `%I` with the same raw instance string. In systemd, `%i` is the instance as written in the unit name (still escaped), while `%I` is the unescaped instance. Thus for a unit such as `ingress@crq\x2dtick.socket`, `Service=%I.service` should resolve to `crq-tick.service`, but this code leaves `crq\x2dtick.service`, so the dependency scan can miss the actual target unit. The fix is to unescape only the `%I` replacement.
